title: Clan forts
changes: Every clan's Hold is now a large isometric fort or war camp in its own style: Warden palisade and watchtowers, Redfang hide tents and skull totems, the Ossuary Host's crooked bone-and-stone keep, Hide-Kin earthworks around a burrow mound, and the Veiled Circle's walled sandstone shrine.
Heroes can walk through the Holds as before; they are only for show.
